description: This file is an Express.js router module for managing shopping cart operations in a food ordering backend, defining routes for retrieving, adding, updating, removing, and clearing cart items, with Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches the current active cart for the authenticated user.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's cart with specified menu item ID, quantity, and optional notes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity or notes of a specific cart item identified by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the cart based on its ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the user's cart.
